svg.aria-label: The pi-crucible workflow: launch, spec (Opus), implement (Sonnet), a diff (Haiku) before each round of parallel review lenses (Opus), up to two revise rounds (Sonnet), integration with main (Haiku, one Sonnet fix round), then a PR (Sonnet) that a human merges. Spec or implement can stop and flag a human.
